goal.objective: Build a fully automated factory producing at least one automation-science-pack per game minute from natural resources.

definition.summary: Build a fully automated factory producing at least one automation-science-pack per game minute from natural resources.

nodes.why_it_matters: Smelt and collect 10 copper plates from natural ore and verify the electronics production trigger. This is a finite bootstrap, not the final automatic copper supply.
Produce the 50 iron plates required by the steam-power trigger and verify the unlock. Prefer the held burner miner for a reusable direct-fed iron cell after checking its setup cost.
Provide a running electrical network under a real load. Separate pump installation, boiler connection, engine connection, and electrical verification at fresh-geometry boundaries.
After electronics and steam-power unlock the lab recipe, craft one lab to perform the exact automation-science-pack research trigger and verify completion.
Make the 10 bootstrap automation-science-packs required for automation research, supply a powered lab, and verify automation before building assembling-machine-1.
Extract natural coal and automatically deliver it to the boiler and any retained burner machines. Exit only when normal operation no longer needs hand-carried fuel.
assumptions: Check mining and transport recipe unlocks before choosing the equipment.

nodes.why_it_matters: Connect natural iron extraction, smelting, fuel where needed, and plate transport without hand-fed ore or intermediary stock. Size the route using live rates.
Connect natural copper extraction, smelting, fuel where needed, and plate transport without hand-fed ore or intermediary stock. Validate the route's capacity.
Run an unlocked, powered assembler from automatically supplied iron plates and deliver its gears onward without manual ingredient insertion.
Feed automatically produced copper plates and gears into powered science assembly, with automatic output removal. Validate actual transport capacity against the selected rate.

Verify the complete natural-resource and fuel routes, allow hand-fed startup inputs to clear, and measure at least one automation-science-pack per minute over a full uncontaminated game-minute window.

steps.description: Acquire 10 copper ore and 10 coal for the electronics bootstrap, retaining the held furnace.

execution_guidance.approach: Manually acquire 10 copper ore and a 10-coal bootstrap reserve; reuse the held furnace and preserve the held miner for subsequent iron work.
execution_guidance.rationale: Only 10 copper plates are needed now. Manual supply avoids a second machine installation and output alignment. Direct feeding benefits repeated demand; extra cells have no demonstrated payback for this batch.
constraints: Use natural copper ore and coal; do not take player stock.
Reuse the held furnace rather than crafting a duplicate.
The coal reserve is startup stock, not automatic fuel delivery.

steps.description: Install the held stone furnace for copper smelting; observe its new exact identity before supplying it.

execution_guidance.approach: Place one held stone furnace near the selected copper work area, then obtain its live identity and inspect its state before exact supply.
execution_guidance.rationale: The furnace is already owned. Its placement is a necessary identity boundary; a presence checkpoint must not imply that smelting or automatic supply is working.
constraints: End this step at furnace presence, not production.
Read the new exact furnace identity before transferring inputs.
Keep later automatic copper routing tentative.

steps.description: Smelt and collect 10 copper plates, then verify that electronics research is complete.

execution_guidance.approach: Use the exact furnace to smelt the 10 acquired copper ore, collect 10 copper plates, and verify electronics research.
execution_guidance.rationale: The live research path requires production of 10 copper plates. Furnace production performs that trigger; submitting lab research or attempting hand-crafted plates does not.
constraints: Check the enabled copper-smelting recipe and fuel requirement before supply.
Require both 10 held copper plates and completed electronics research.
Do not treat this hand-fed bootstrap as autonomous production.
